title: DCP r-Copy Secret-Twirled Tensor-Power Density Matrix and Ternary Kernel Moment Bridge
claims: The secret-twirled r-copy DCP state bar_rho^{(r)}(A) satisfies ||bar_rho^{(r)}(A) - I_{2^r}/2^r||_F^2 = 2^{-r} sum_{0 != delta in {-1,0,1}^r : A delta == 0 mod q} prod_{j: delta_j != 0} (gamma_j^2 / 2).
Because +/- 1 is a unit modulo every q >= 2, E_A[||bar_rho^{(r)}(A) - I_{2^r}/2^r||_F^2] = (prod_{j=1}^r (1 + gamma_j^2) - 1) / (2^r * q^n) holds identically across all moduli q >= 2.
